title: Readiness aggregation and invariant alignment preserve measured semantics
statement: Composite sensor execution MUST distinguish process execution from readiness and MUST preserve pass, review, fail, unknown, N/A, and error without translating N/A, REVIEW, or UNKNOWN into PASS or binary FAIL; invariant alignment MUST require an executable fail-closed canonical action plus fresh successful candidate-bound evidence, and MUST reject comments, echoes, quoted commands, disabled or continue-on-error steps, ignored failures, and stale evidence.
rationale: Exit codes alone discard the uncertainty and applicability information the scorecard exists to preserve. Text presence is not proof that a requirement was executed or passed.

strategy.rationale: The registered test corpus provides deterministic regression evidence for this invariant.
